artworks.title: Hercules and the Hydra
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 21.9 x 28.3 cm (8 5/8 x 11 1/8 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip and Judith Benedict
artworks.description: A drawing showing a warrior facing off against a dragon. The warrior is depicted as muscular and bearded, with a dynamic posture and a billowing cloak. The dragon has detailed scales, wings, and a fierce expression. The image uses strong lines to create a dramatic scene, with a lightly suggested background of tree branches.

artworks.title: Mephistopheles in the Air
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on chine collé

artworks.title: Clovis and Clotilda
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip and Judith Benedict
artworks.description: There is a drawing of an ornate framed scene with pastoral elements. The central image portrays two horses, one with riders, galloping through a rugged and hilly landscape. Trees and distant buildings are visible in the background, offering a classic pastoral view. The scene is enclosed within an elaborate frame with leaf motifs and angelic figures at the top corner, adding a baroque touch. The artwork showcases a blend of intricate patterns and vivid movement, emphasizing the artist's attention to detail and classical influences.

artworks.title: Adelphi Wharf
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to image): 25.2 x 30.9 cm (9 15/16 x 12 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of draft horses walking under a stone archway. The scene shows a team of horses moving through a tunnel, illuminated by light creating shadows on the cobblestone path beneath them. The horses are depicted in detail, showing their harnesses and muscular build. The archway is composed of roughly-hewn stones. The composition highlights the movement and texture of the horses and the stone structure above them.

artworks.title: Landscape
artworks.medium: charcoal on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts a landscape from a slightly elevated point of view. Trees line the horizon, blending into the surroundings. The drawing features expressive strokes creating texture, likely in charcoal or ink. The monochromatic color palette is dominated by black and gray. A body of water is visible, reflecting trees and vegetation. Trees continue into the distance, creating depth. The landscape softens in the distance.

artworks.title: Winter
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image depicts an older man standing, holding a lantern in his left hand. He wears a cloak with fur trim and a hood covering most of his head. The background shows a winter landscape with trees, snow-covered ground, buildings, and a bridge. The man's facial features are detailed, including a long white beard. Various mythological or celestial figures and inscriptions surround the central image.

artworks.title: Baigneuses
artworks.medium: lithograph (zinc) in black on chine collé
artworks.description: The image shows several figures at the water's edge, some standing in the shallow water and others preparing to enter. The waterline separates the water from a landscape of trees and foliage in the distance. The brushstrokes and lines are loose, creating an impressionistic feel, with darker shadows defining the trees and water reflections. The color palette is monochromatic, using shades of black, white, and gray to convey form and texture.

artworks.title: Saint Jerome Reading
artworks.medium: etching with some engraving and drypoint on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 19.1 x 25.3 cm (7 1/2 x 9 15/16 in.)
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip and Judith Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows an elderly man sitting and looking down at a piece of paper he is holding. He has a bald head with a beard, and is wearing minimal clothing. Rocks and a skull are nearby. In the background, there is a lion and rocky formations with sparse trees and clouds in the sky.

artworks.title: The Marriage of Angelica and Medoro
artworks.medium: etching on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to plate mark): 24 x 25.9 cm (9 7/16 x 10 3/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a rustic scene featuring four individuals gathered outside a thatched-roof structure. Two figures are seated in the foreground, engaged in conversation. A standing figure wearing a broad-brimmed hat and carrying a cane leans in, while another figure observes from the entrance of the building. The detailed linework captures the textures of the fabric and the thatched roof. The background includes a cloudy sky and rustic fence line.

artworks.title: Saint Martin of Tours Healing the Servant of Tetrodius
artworks.medium: watercolor and gouache over black chalk on four joined sheets of laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Ailsa Mellon Bruce Fund and Pepita Milmore Memorial Fund
artworks.description: This is a painting depicting a scene with figures engaged in an interaction. The composition shows movement and emotion, with figures conveying distress and urgency. The central focus is on a group of people, with an individual prominently positioned and partially reclined, being supported by others. An authoritative figure in rich attire gestures towards this scene from the left. To the right, against a grand architectural backdrop, a person in regal clothing is seated on a throne, observing the scene below. The color palette consists of earthy tones, with shadows and highlights adding depth to the interactions. The style is reminiscent of a renaissance or baroque artist, capturing intricate costume details and dramatic expressions.

artworks.title: Clouds over a Forest
artworks.medium: brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image displays a vast sky filled with voluminous clouds and a strip of dark land near the low horizon. The clouds are soft and expressive, with smooth transitions between tones. The color palette is sepia, accentuating the contrast between the sky and land.

artworks.title: The Isar with Boulders on the Isarhohe
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash over traces of graphite on laid paper
artworks.description: This image displays a landscape from an elevated perspective. The horizon is near the upper third of the image, portrayed by distant mountains. Two figures are seated on a hill with a winding path leading further into the scene. Trees are depicted with detailed brushstrokes, dominating the landscape. The sepia color palette provides a vintage feel. In the distance, a small structure is nestled among the trees.

artworks.title: A River Bank with Mountains Beyond
artworks.medium: brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a landscape with a lower perspective looking up at a large hillside or cliffs. The horizon is positioned in the upper third of the image, marked by the crest of the hill. Wispy clouds are seen just below this line in the sky. The hillside has broad brushstrokes indicating a rough texture, while trees below it are painted with intricate, shorter strokes. A body of water flows horizontally in front, with its surface depicted using horizontal brushstrokes. The color palette is monochromatic, consisting of different shades of brown.

artworks.title: A Woman Seated on a Cloud, Seen from Below
artworks.medium: pen and brown ink with brown wash on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows an ink sketch of a person viewed from a low, upward perspective. The figure is depicted from the waist up, with one arm extended to the side and the other bent towards the chest. The person's head is turned slightly, with simple facial features and curly hair. They are wearing flowing robes with detailed folds, suggesting movement. The background is plain.

artworks.title: The Bearing of the Cross
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from three blocks: black line block and two tone blocks in shades of green-brown on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed to borderline): 31.1 x 23.2 cm (12 1/4 x 9 1/8 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group gathered around a central figure carrying a cross. The scene depicts multiple figures dressed in period clothing, gathered tightly in a circular composition. The central figure is kneeling holding a cross, while others around him express a mix of concern, effort, and tension. Strong lines and shading emphasize the intensity of the scene, highlighted by a monochromatic scheme. The artist's technique uses cross-hatching and outlines to convey texture and emotion, drawing attention to the array of expressions and postures within the composition.

artworks.title: The Weather Peasant Facing Right
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a figure facing away, holding a forked object. The composition shows a person from behind, dressed in a coat and boots, standing on a rocky ground with some vegetation around. The figure holds a long forked implement over the shoulder, while a bag appears at their side on the ground. Above their head, a banner with text unfolds, displaying "ES IST KALT WETER." The drawing is monochromatic, utilizing linework to convey texture and form, suggestive of a woodcut or engraving style. The letters "HSB" can be seen in the design.

artworks.title: The Weather Peasant Facing Left
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing with their back to the viewer. The individual has their hands behind their back, looking to the left. Their facial features are in profile, with a defined nose and a slightly weathered appearance. They wear a close-fitting hat, a long coat with a large pocket, knee-length trousers, and sturdy boots with straps. The person holds a whip behind their back. In the background, there is a rustic fence and sparse vegetation. A decorative banner with text is above and beside the person.

artworks.title: Vanitas
artworks.medium: engraving on laid paper
artworks.dimensions: sheet (trimmed within plate mark): 32.1 x 25.4 cm (12 5/8 x 10 in.)
artworks.description: This print features a human skull at the center, placed on sheets of paper with a book or journal to the right and large shell-like shape to the left. A crumpled piece of paper with "OMNIA VANITAS" written on it rests in front of the shell, and there is a candlestick next to it with smoke curling upward. Next to the smoke are what appear to be two transparent bubbles floating above the skull. Drapes are visible in the background, and there are flowers on the right.

artworks.title: Christmas Eve Procession to San Giorgio Maggiore
artworks.artist: Giovanni Battista Brustolon after Giovanni Battista Moretti
artworks.medium: etching and engraving on laid paper

artworks.title: Le Couvre-Feu (The Curfew) [recto]
artworks.medium: etching, drypoint, aquatint, and burnishing in black on light blue wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a nocturnal scene with a low horizon, featuring dark silhouettes of buildings, including a church spire. The etching technique is evident in the fine lines that create texture and depth, especially in the sky and reflection on the ground. The color palette is primarily monochromatic, with shades of brown. Light illuminates a few figures and casts reflections on the ground. Trees with skeletal branches are visible to the right.

artworks.title: Figures on a Shore [verso]
artworks.medium: graphite on wove paper
artworks.description: The image is a pencil sketch of a seascape with a horizon slightly above the center. The waves meet the sky and blend into the sandy texture of the paper. There are faint lines and dots on the horizon. Delicate brushstrokes create a serene scene. The palette is monochromatic. In the foreground, there are simple outlines of a small group of people on the beach. The sky dominates the composition, highlighting the open landscape.

artworks.title: Judith and Holofernes
artworks.medium: chiaroscuro woodcut printed from 3 blocks: black line block and 2 tones blocks in shades of brown on laid paper
artworks.creditLine: Gift of Philip and Judith Benedict
artworks.description: The image shows a person standing at the center, gazing outward. The person has curly hair, slightly pursed lips, and detailed facial features. They wear draped garments with a belt-like tie, and hold an object in their right hand. Another person holds a tray nearby. The background has abstract, flowing lines.

artworks.title: Death of Adonis
artworks.medium: woodcut on laid paper
artworks.dimensions:
image (within borderline): 24.7 x 28.9 cm (9 3/4 x 11 3/8 in.)
sheet: 26.8 x 32.3 cm (10 9/16 x 12 11/16 in.)
artworks.description: This is a drawing of a group of figures in an outdoor setting. The composition features several figures reclining or sitting on a natural surface beside a tree, surrounded by a flowing landscape indicating a body of water and various textures suggesting waves or currents. In the background, there is a procession of figures riding mythical creatures, lending a narrative element to the scene. The linework is bold, defining the contours of the figures and landscape.

artworks.title: Dire que je vais être... exposé...
artworks.medium: lithograph in black on wove paper
artworks.description: The image shows a family looking at a bust in an exhibition. There are three figures—an adult male and female, and a child—standing in front of a pedestal with the bust. The setting appears to be an exhibition space, as indicated by the title "L'EXPOSITION DE 1859." The figures display exaggerated features typical of caricature, with the man having a pronounced nose and a high collar, the woman has crossed arms, and the child looks up at the bust. The drawing features strong lines and cross-hatching, adding texture and depth. Text at the bottom humorously indicates the man's desire to be accurately depicted in the bust.
